title: GovZero Exemplar Corpus
description: Registry of pinned exemplar projects across the ten archetypal complexity cells (ADR-0.0.27). Validated by gz validate --documents; drift from the Pydantic model is fail-closed.

schema_version.description: Schema version string for the corpus file format.

corpus_revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision number for the corpus content.

projects.description: Ordered array of pinned exemplar projects.

vacant_cells.description: Cells with no qualifying project; rationale required for each.

archetypal_cell.description: Archetypal cell index (1-10) from ADR-0.0.27 Decision.

cell_label.description: Human-readable label for the archetypal cell.

included_paths.description: Glob patterns for paths included in measurement (at least one required).

excluded_paths_with_rationale.description: Paths excluded from measurement with per-path rationale.

path_filter_rationale.description: Overall rationale for the included/excluded path selection.

longevity_evidence.description: Evidence the project has been active for 5+ years.

maintenance_health_evidence.description: Evidence of healthy maintenance (e.g. recent release date).

practitioner_reputation_citation.description: Specific citation (PEP number, book title, talk name) grounding reputation.

pure_python_loc_ratio.description: Fraction of included LOC that is pure Python (0.0-1.0).

craftsmanship_signal_narrative.description: Narrative explaining the craftsmanship signal this project exemplifies.

project_doctrine_fitness_narrative.description: Narrative explaining why this project fits the corpus doctrine.

exclusion_rationale.description: Why this path is excluded (e.g. irreducible algorithmic complexity, generated code).

archetypal_cell.description: Archetypal cell index (1-10) that has no qualifying project.

vacancy_rationale.description: Why no project was found that satisfies the selection criteria for this cell.
